output.title: What hours can we schedule a member callback?
output.draft_text:
Q: What hours can we schedule a callback?

A: Schedule member callbacks on weekdays between 8:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. Eastern (source: U-KNOWN-FACT).

When scheduling:
- Callbacks may only be scheduled Monday through Friday, between 8:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. Eastern.
- If the member is in a different time zone, convert their preferred time to Eastern before booking. [Confirm whether advocates should record the callback time in Eastern or the member's local time.]
- Weekend callbacks: [state whether weekend callbacks are permitted under any circumstances, or confirm they are not available].
- Holidays: [list observed holidays or link to the holiday schedule, and state whether callbacks can be scheduled on those days].
- Latest bookable slot: [confirm whether a callback can be booked to start at 6:00 p.m. Eastern or whether the last slot is earlier, e.g., [latest start time]].
- To schedule the callback, use [system or tool name and steps].
- If the member requests a time outside these hours, [describe what the advocate should offer or do instead].
